Every line you add becomes its own video.
Piper en_US-ljspeech-medium, bundled inside the APK.
1080×1920 · H.264 (AVC) + AAC · black background · white text\nWorks with no internet permission at all.
%1$d clips · %2$.1f s of video · ZIP %3$.2f MB\n%4$s · rendered in %5$.1f s

ShortsGen %1$s

Type your script line by line. Each line is spoken by the bundled Piper voice (en_US-ljspeech-medium) and rendered as its own 1080×1920 H.264 clip: black background, white text wrapped inside a 680×1320 box, and a duration that matches the speech.

All clips are packed into one ZIP that you can save to your Download folder.

The app has no internet permission - the voice model, phonemizer data, font and codecs are all on the device.
